description: This PHP source file defines the class 'MssqlManager', a database manager class responsible for handling Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) database operations within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for connecting to the database, executing queries, managing schemas, handling full-text indexes, and other SQL Server specific functionality.

classes.name: MssqlManager
classes.description: A class for managing MSSQL database interactions, including connection setup, query execution, schema modifications, and full-text search indexing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MSSQL database using configuration options.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the connected MSSQL server.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query against the MSSQL database.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Executes a paginated query with limit and offset support.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: tablesLike
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names matching a pattern.

methods.name: getTablesArray
methods.description: Fetches all table names in the current database.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_setup
methods.description: Sets up full-text indexing components in the database.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_installed
methods.description: Checks whether full-text indexing is installed on the server.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_enabled
methods.description: Checks whether full-text indexing is enabled for the database.

methods.name: create_default_full_text_catalog
methods.description: Creates a default full-text catalog if necessary.

methods.name: getFieldDefaultConstraintName
methods.description: Retrieves the automatically generated default constraint name for a column.

methods.name: save_audit_records
methods.description: Saves changes to module's audit table, with special handling for date data types.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the database and performs cleanup.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees a database query result resource.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Retrieves the last database error message, filtering certain known non-errors.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database, such as version.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Pre-validates a query by checking if it is a SELECT and analyzing its execution plan.

methods.name: _appendN
methods.description: Utility to prepend 'N' for SQL string literals to indicate Unicode data, handling quotes and special cases.

methods.name: quoteTerm
methods.description: Quotes and formats search terms for fulltext search in SQL Server.

methods.name: getFulltextQuery
methods.description: Builds a fulltext search condition string from given terms with inclusion, exclusion, and must-have logic.

methods.name: dbExists
methods.description: Checks whether a specific database exists.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Selects a database context.

methods.name: userExists
methods.description: Checks whether a specific user login exists.

methods.name: createDbUser
methods.description: Creates a new database login and user with role memberships.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops an existing database.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the MSSQL PHP extension is available for use.

methods.name: isDatabaseNameValid
methods.description: Validates a database name to prevent invalid characters.

methods.name: installConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration parameters for database setup.

methods.name: getFromDummyTable
methods.description: Provides a dummy FROM clause if needed, often empty for MSSQL.

methods.name: getGuidSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL expression for generating a new GUID/UUID.

methods.name: removeIndexLimit
methods.description: Removes index length limits from field definitions.
